query: I have a 77-year-old man to evaluate: among male Medicare patients aged 72–82 who were transferred from another hospital and had unstable angina as the principal diagnosis at admission with discharge recorded, how many total admissions met these criteria?
final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS total_admissions
FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
INNER JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
  ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id
INNER JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` d
  ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = d.hadm_id
WHERE p.gender = 'M'
  AND a.insurance = 'Medicare'
  AND a.admission_location = 'TRANSFER'
  AND a.hospital_expire_flag = 0
  AND d.seq_num = 1
  AND (
    (d.icd_version = 9 AND d.icd_code = '411.1')
    OR
    (d.icd_version = 10 AND d.icd_code = 'I20.0')
  )
  AND 72 <= (p.anchor_age + (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) - 2008))
  AND (p.anchor_age + (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) - 2008)) <= 82;
